patches_modified.name: Clean up Reels
patches_modified.description: Hides clutter on reels, such as the Follow button, comment previews, Remix and Use template buttons and Threads cards or Meta promos between reels, so more of the video shows, and can play each reel once instead of over and over, keep its original audio instead of a Meta AI dub, drop the search suggestions under the caption, over the comments and at the top of a profile's reels, or hide the like, comment and share counts, the Like, Comment, Repost, Share, Save or speaker button, the line naming the reel's sound, the "AI content" label or the hashtags in its caption. It can also keep the Reels tab to accounts you follow, open a video you tap in the feed on its own, with no reels after it, do the same for a reel you open from a link or a chat, keep the Add friend pop-up off a reel someone who isn't your friend sent you, play a feed video again right there when you tap Watch again instead of opening Reels, play a video you tap in Saved in the video player instead of Reels, go on to the next reel in Saved instead of a suggested one, keep reels playing without stopping to ask "Are you still watching?", fill a tall screen with a reel or a full-screen video instead of leaving black bars around it, with a pinch to see one reel whole, take the UP NEXT bar off the bottom of a video you open from the feed, hide the Fullscreen button under a wide video or the full-screen and picture-in-picture buttons on videos in the feed and search results, stop the "This is taking a while" message when a video is slow to load, and play whole reels in the feed's Reels row instead of the same second over and over, or show reels in the feed at their own shape instead of cut down to a wider frame, or keep the Comment button on reels with comments turned off so you can read them, put Like, Comment, Share and Save back beside long videos, and hide the one-tap Subscribe button some authors get instead of Follow, or Search and the button beside it at the top of a video you open and of the Reels tab, and show when a reel or video was posted, or take "New for you" off the line under a reel's author. Its Burn-in guard can fade a reel's buttons, caption and bars when you leave them alone, so they don't burn into the screen. With Turn off HDR brightness patched too, it can show Reels in gray, video and all. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches_modified.name: Skip ads (v17)
patches_modified.description: Removes the ads, ad markers, and pause ads from on-demand videos on Pluto TV v17. Live TV ads are part of the broadcast and are not removed. Hook design ported from semicoloncolonel's tv-morphe-patches.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes Pluto TV's on-demand (VOD) ads on the v17.x rebuild (the Paramount+/AVIA player stack). Four layers: (1+2) force AVIA's DAI and IMA shouldPlayAd() gates to false so the pre-roll ad pods are skipped natively; (3) drop the ad <Period>s from the stitched multi-period DASH manifest at AVIA's own DashParser and re-base the content periods into a contiguous timeline, so the mid-roll ad VIDEO is never played AND the seekbar tracks correctly; (4) suppress the ID3/CLID3-driven CSAI ad call on static VOD manifests. Also hides pause ads and stops ad impression beacons for the removed breaks. Fail-open: a manifest it can't rewrite is passed through unchanged (ads remain, playback never breaks). LIVE TV ads are real broadcast time in the linear feed and are not removable. Validated on-device, 17.2.0.

patches_added.name: Unlock premium (native)
patches_added.description: Stops the native engine from verifying the licence, which is what the premium actions are gated on once the licence checks out in Java.

patches_removed.name: ADB server log
patches_removed.description: Writes the native ADB server's own log to /data/local/tmp/tvqa-server.log and lets its debug messages through. The server is started again every few seconds and nothing of what it says is reachable otherwise: its logger is built at a level that drops every message, and its output is sent to /dev/null. Use this to find out why it ends, not as a fix.

patches_removed.name: Input without the ADB server
patches_removed.description: Keeps key, pointer and gamepad input working when the "ADB speed up" server is not running. The app only asks whether speed-up is enabled, not whether the server it starts as the shell user on localhost:15000 is up, and it drops the request without falling back when the port is closed - so numpad keys and mouse input do nothing. Each of those requests is now gated on the app's own port probe, and the injection site's ordinary path runs while no server is listening.

patches_removed.name: Never stop itself
patches_removed.description: Keeps the app from stopping its own package. Stop recent apps, Restart app and Force stop app all end in `am force-stop <package>` run over ADB, and the app is in the recents list it works from, so once an ADB connection is up the app stops itself, restarts, and loops every few seconds. The app only skips the foreground app, and only when the matching preference is enabled, so this covers what the preference does not. Custom ADB command actions are covered too, and such a command is logged under the TVQA-GUARD tag before it is dropped.

patches_removed.name: Unlock native engine
patches_removed.description: Patches the native engine libraries so that they run on a re-signed APK. The anti-tamper constructor of libd.so that destroys a global mutex is disabled, and the trap instructions the verification routine plants inside its own code - udf #0 (SIGILL) and stores of the markers 0xdead and 0xdeadbeef (SIGSEGV) - are replaced by no-ops, leaving the routine's work intact. This is what makes Web Widget Overlay and button emulation work. The server-only liba.so self-stop calls are also disabled for ARM32 and ARM64 so ADB speed-up does not terminate the app.

patches_modified.name: Unlock premium
patches_modified.description: Reports the app as licensed and stops the native engine from verifying the licence, which unlocks the premium features.
patches_modified.previous_description: Makes the bundled Google LVL policy always report the app as licensed, which unlocks the premium features.

patches_modified.previous_description: Bypasses PairIP license check ('Download from Play Store'), Play Integrity, and signature verification to allow modified and sideloaded app usage.

patches_modified.name: Unlock premium
patches_modified.description: Forces DiskWala's native session state to logged-in + premium, unlocking the ads-free experience and premium UI. RevenueCat is also patched as a best-effort fallback.
patches_modified.previous_description: Makes RevenueCat entitlements appear active so ads-free and premium features are unlocked.

patches_removed.name: Patch native libraries
patches_removed.description: Neutralizes PairIP traps in native .so libraries and patches Hermes bundle.

patches_modified.name: Disable ads
patches_modified.description: Prevents AppLovin, Google MobileAds, Vungle, IronSource/LevelPlay, Mintegral, BigoAds, BidMachine and Meta Audience Network from initializing, so no ads are requested.
patches_modified.previous_description: Stubs AppLovin, AdMob, InMobi and other ad SDKs at the bytecode level to prevent ads from loading without breaking the app.

patches_modified.name: Save management
patches_modified.description: Export and import all saves as a zip, keep up to 10 saves of each game, and Undo / Redo. Optional public, uncompressed save files.

patches_added.description: Lets your chats show through the floating tab bar at the bottom, as much as you pick in HushMessenger's settings. The tab you're on and the icons stay as they are. Needs Floating tab bar, or Messenger's own floating bar. Restart Messenger to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Keep HDR on photo uploads
patches_added.description: Lets an Ultra HDR photo you post keep its HDR gain map on Android 14 and newer. Experimental. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches_modified.name: Full screen Reels and Home
patches_modified.description: Hides the status bar and the navigation bar while Reels shows, and optionally on Home, your messages, stories, Explore or your profile. Swipe in from the edge to bring them back for a moment. Back and the keyboard work as usual. It can also show stories over the whole screen on tall phones. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels (Full screen Reels), Feed (Full screen Home), Messages (Full screen Messages), Stories (Full screen stories, Stories fill the screen), Explore (Full screen Explore) and Profiles (Full screen profile).

Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels (Full screen Reels), Feed (Full screen Home), Messages (Full screen Messages) and Stories (Stories fill the screen).

patches_modified.name: Hide Meta AI
patches_modified.description: Removes Meta AI from Instagram's search bars, messages, home top bar, reels menus, share sheet, stories and feed, and its restyle credits from stories and reels. Each part has its own switch. The search one and the Meta AI posts one start on, the rest start off. Change them in HushGram settings > Meta AI.

patches_modified.name: Hide the reply box on stories
patches_modified.description: Takes the Send message box off the bottom of other people's stories. The like and share buttons next to it stay where they are. Switches of their own take the Like, Comment and Share buttons off too, with no empty space left behind, and the comments floating over stories. A choice lifts the line for writing a comment. All start off. Set them in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Saved on your profile
patches_modified.description: Adds a bookmark to the tabs on your own profile, beside posts, reels and tagged, that opens Saved on All, a handle to drag through Saved and your collections, and switches that hide the + for a new collection, Saved's Reels tab and the Saved bookmark on the Search tab. The same handle can run down Home and your chats. All start off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Profiles, Feed and Messages. The bookmarks need an Instagram restart.
